title: Move to (V) a split that is one label
steps: On the fake data, open Settings > Split inbox, click Add split..., name it Client tab, type label:"Clients" and Save
In the Inbox press V on a conversation and type client tab
expected: Step 2: V shows Places, Splits and Labels headers; Client tab is under Splits with a small split tag and the cursor on it, and Clients is not listed again under Labels. Step 3: the toast says Moved to Client tab and the conversation leaves the Inbox with the Clients label (find it in that label, not the tab, since it left the Inbox); Cmd-Z puts it back in the Inbox without the label.
